That cure of life, shall whisper of poison.

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother is coming to PlayStation®5 in early 2027. 

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother is the first-ever console game adaptation of the popular franchise "The Apothecary Diaries", featuring a brand-new story conceptualized by series author Hyuganatsu.

Two chains of strange phenomenon and conspiracies are causing chaos throughout the rear palace, red-light district, and streets of the capital. Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother before it destroys the imperial court.

The free playable demo of DRAGON QUEST Monsters: The Withered World allows you to experience the game from the start of the story up to the conclusion of events in Witherwood as you get to grips with recruiting, raising, and synthesizing monsters. 

For playing the demo, you can receive an item set for use in the full game. And, if you keep your save data from the demo, you'll be able to transfer up to 8 monsters from your main party and reserves into the full game.

*Only monsters of rank G and rank F can be befriended in the demo.
*Bonus content cannot be claimed in the demo.

Bonuses for playing the Demo
- Wrangler's Bundle
    ・Ring of Impulse x1
    ・Bonus Ball x1
    ・Smoked Sirloin x5

DRAGON QUEST Monsters: The Withered World launches on December 3, 2026 on PlayStation 5.
